what: confluence zones of the decision-card names, as CZ1 computed them: two or more levels within 1% of each other; members by the Lab's own labels

rule.zone: two or more levels all within 1% of each other (top no more than 1% above bottom); closest neighbours joined first
rule.multi_source: members come from at least two sources: two source timeframes, or a line and a moving average
rule.averages: simple moving averages of completed daily closes: 21, 50, 100, 200
rule.lasts: price stays at the last close; each average rolls its real window forward
